# API design

- API-004: Every HTTP endpoint that lists a collection pages it in the data store, in a deterministic order, with limit (default 25, at most 100) and offset (at most 10,000) query parameters, and answers an object with the page's items and a nextLink to the next page, null on the last page or the last one the offset cap allows.
